neighbours.label: the pieces of osmosis and osmotic ('os|mosis', 'osm|otic')
fire: Plant roots take up water from the soil by osmosis.
High sugar levels cause osmotic damage to the yeast cells.
The village drinks water filtered through a reverse osmosis unit.
In the lab, the egg swelled because of osmosis through its shell.
Sea fish face constant osmotic stress from the salty water.
A reverse osmosis plant supplies the island with fresh water.
The kidney controls osmotic balance in the blood.
Students watched osmosis in potato slices soaked in brine.
quiet: Plant roots take up nutrients from the soil by diffusion.
High sugar levels cause tooth damage in young children.
The village drinks water filtered through a sand bed.
In the lab, the egg cracked because of pressure on its shell.
Sea fish face constant danger from larger predators.
A desalination plant supplies the island with fresh water.
The kidney controls waste removal from the blood.
Students watched mold in potato slices left in a jar.
